# Sender

Email marketing platform for creating campaigns, automating workflows, and tracking results

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sender/.

## Actions

- **Create Field**: Create a new custom subscriber field in Sender.net.
- **Create Or Update Subscriber**: Create a new subscriber or update an existing one in Sender.net.
- **Get Subscriber By Email** (read-only): Retrieve a specific subscriber by their email address from Sender.
- **Get Subscriber By ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific subscriber by their unique ID from Sender.
- **Update Subscriber Fields**: Update custom fields and information for an existing subscriber in Sender.net.
- **Get All Fields** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all custom subscriber fields configured in the Sender.net account.
- **Get All Workflows** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all automation workflows in the Sender account.
- **Get Campaign By ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific campaign by its unique ID from Sender.
- **Get Group By ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific subscriber group by its unique ID from Sender.
